_doc: The loose cultivators of the north: named spirit beasts (linh thú). Proposal, unpriced (review/RANKED.md A7, 2026-11-25; form of sects/cuu_cao.beasts.json). An owned beast is a people record with is_beast and owner_id, and its owner lists it in `beasts` (src/gameplay/character/beast_keeper.gd, assets/data/creatures_linh_thu.json). Capacity is 1 + floor(effective thần hồn / 40). In a fight it is a companion: it adds power_share (0.5) of its chiến lực to its owner's offense, strikes every basic_cooldown, cannot be targeted and never leaves the fight (Combat rule 19). `combat` and `bond` are depth fields; `bond.rider` marks a mount, `bond.keeper` a beast that is not ridden. The owners' cast records do not list these beasts yet.

beasts.appearance: A grey lynx with black ear tufts, always at his heel.

combat.note: The lynx in front (his Beast Den node).

bond.rule: Raised from a kit he did not sell.

beasts.backstory: The one kit of a litter Quản Tuyết Tung kept instead of selling at Quy Điểu Trấn's ice market. It hunts with him in Lãnh Nguyệt Lâm and will not go near Quần Lang Lâm.
